dawson-bruckman.text: Endorsed by the Wiseburn Faculty Association (teachers union).

source.title: Bruckman for Wiseburn School Board (campaign site)

dawson-bruckman.text: Says that in 4,508 recorded votes from 2018-2026 the board never voted down a contract, and nearly half of items pass bundled on consent: "A board can follow every rule and not show its work."

source.title: Bruckman for Wiseburn School Board (campaign site)

dawson-bruckman.text: Would put a yearly workforce report in open session covering staffing, caseloads, turnover and onboarding; noted teachers' 2025-26 raises were approved more than nine months after the superintendent's.

source.title: Bruckman for Wiseburn School Board (campaign site)

dawson-bruckman.text: Pledges to question the 2026-27 budget's staffing reductions at Del Aire Elementary at the December First Interim review: "I'm not promising positions. I'm promising the question."

source.title: Bruckman for Wiseburn School Board (campaign site)
